title: Double acute is distinct
description_en: Preserve ő/ű/Ő/Ű versus ö/ü/Ö/Ü. Never substitute lookalikes or remove marks in capitals.
requirement: Preserve ő/ű/Ő/Ű versus ö/ü/Ö/Ü. Never substitute lookalikes or remove marks in capitals.

title: Normalization and original bytes
description_en: Keep composed ő and o plus U+030B as original bytes. Derived NFC comparison is diagnostic and never authorizes a rewrite.
requirement: Keep composed ő and o plus U+030B as original bytes. Derived NFC comparison is diagnostic and never authorizes a rewrite.

title: Letter versus grapheme
description_en: cs/dzs/ny can be orthographic letters while containing multiple grapheme clusters. Do not use generic grapheme counts as Hungarian alphabet counts.
requirement: cs/dzs/ny can be orthographic letters while containing multiple grapheme clusters. Do not use generic grapheme counts as Hungarian alphabet counts.

title: Contextual casing
description_en: Cs/Dzs and all-caps CS/DZS are different contexts; avoid first-codepoint-only casing or English Title Case.
requirement: Cs/Dzs and all-caps CS/DZS are different contexts; avoid first-codepoint-only casing or English Title Case.

title: Compounds and hyphenation
description_en: Distinguish spelling hyphens, suffix boundaries and discretionary line-end hyphens. Use Hungarian dictionary context, not a guessed syllable split.
requirement: Distinguish spelling hyphens, suffix boundaries and discretionary line-end hyphens. Use Hungarian dictionary context, not a guessed syllable split.

title: Names and suffixes
description_en: Retain official proper names and context-dependent suffix attachment; do not apply blanket name-plus-hyphen or strip suffixes for layout.
requirement: Retain official proper names and context-dependent suffix attachment; do not apply blanket name-plus-hyphen or strip suffixes for layout.

title: Punctuation numbers dates
description_en: Review Hungarian quotes, decimal and date conventions in context; preserve numeric values and original punctuation without automatic locale conversion.
requirement: Review Hungarian quotes, decimal and date conventions in context; preserve numeric values and original punctuation without automatic locale conversion.

title: Name order and titles
description_en: Preserve official Hungarian names and supplied ordering; check use and audience before proposing a different name order or title style.
requirement: Preserve official Hungarian names and supplied ordering; check use and audience before proposing a different name order or title style.

title: Information structure
description_en: Hungarian word order carries focus and meaning; do not move words merely to reduce line length.
requirement: Hungarian word order carries focus and meaning; do not move words merely to reduce line length.

title: Voice and address
description_en: Treat formal/informal address, spoken/written style and te/Ön as separate contextual choices; change only when requested.
requirement: Treat formal/informal address, spoken/written style and te/Ön as separate contextual choices; change only when requested.

title: Font file and rights
description_en: Test actual files, weight, fallback and embedding rights for ő/ű and combining marks; a font recommendation is not a redistribution license.
requirement: Test actual files, weight, fallback and embedding rights for ő/ű and combining marks; a font recommendation is not a redistribution license.

title: Accent clearance
description_en: Verify double-acute clearance and collisions at small/body/display sizes in the target renderer; no current native-rendering claim.
requirement: Verify double-acute clearance and collisions at small/body/display sizes in the target renderer; no current native-rendering claim.

title: Medium-specific hierarchy
description_en: Choose reading/display/hybrid roles, width, actual font and viewing distance. Measured examples are not universal heading ratios.
requirement: Choose reading/display/hybrid roles, width, actual font and viewing distance. Measured examples are not universal heading ratios.

title: Script scope
description_en: Modern hu locale does not imply rovás support or authorize transliteration. Keep historical script evidence separate.
requirement: Modern hu locale does not imply rovás support or authorize transliteration. Keep historical script evidence separate.
